extDescription.message: Find any page you've seen before. Private and local, no account.
extDescription.description: Extension description (store short description is set separately)

searchInputLabel.description: Accessible label of the search input

searchEngineStarting.description: Status while the offscreen engine starts

searchEngineError.message: The local search engine could not be started.
searchEngineError.description: Status when the engine did not answer

onboardingConsentIntro.message: To make your history searchable, Browser Recall reads your Chrome browsing history (page titles, addresses and visit times) and stores a private copy on this device. It never sends it anywhere.
onboardingConsentIntro.description: Consent screen: what is read and where it goes (PRODUCT_SPEC §5.1)

onboardingConsentHeadsUp.message: Chrome's install prompt says the extension can "change" your history. That wording covers delete features; Browser Recall only removes its own copy when you delete history in Chrome or ask it to.
onboardingConsentHeadsUp.description: Consent screen: explains the Chrome permission wording

onboardingDeclined.message: Browser Recall will stay inactive and will not read your history. You can allow it later from this page.

onboardingImporting.message: Importing your history. You can close this page: the import continues in the background and resumes if the browser restarts.

onboardingImportedCount.description: Label before the imported page count

onboardingDone.message: Import complete. Browser Recall keeps your history up to date. Everything stays on this device.
onboardingDone.description: Shown when the import has finished

onboardingError.message: Something went wrong talking to the background service. Please reload this page.
onboardingError.description: Shown when the status request fails
